# authwise_guard_pool_relay (Data Source)

A relay of an estate relay pool. Operators only. Changing `pool` moves the relay; it learns the move on its next report. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `ca_cert_pem` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `guard_pool_relay_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `has_credential` (Boolean)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `last_report_at` (String)
- `pool` (String)
- `priority` (Number)
- `region` (String)
- `reported_version` (String)
- `url` (String)
